title: 从费用投诉到有证据的辅助建议
purpose: 用一通合成客户通话展示实时状态、商业门控、人工权威和 post-call 证据链。

steps.label: 建立通话
steps.description: 绑定客户、通话和受信任的客服身份，初始化投诉权威状态。

steps.label: 客户说明来电原因
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: Hi, I’m calling because I noticed a monthly charge on my account that I don’t recognize.
steps.description: 客户先说明来电原因；平台开始从实时 transcript 建立费用主题。

steps.label: 客服确认并澄清账单
steps.speaker: AGENT
steps.text: I can look into that with you. Let me confirm the account and the date you saw the charge before we decide what to do next.
steps.description: 客服先承接问题并澄清事实，不提前引入额外产品建议。

steps.label: 客户补充账单细节
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: It appeared on my latest statement, and I’m worried I’m paying for something I never asked for.
steps.description: 客户补充账单背景，费用主题持续，但投诉信号还在形成。

steps.label: 客服复述当前问题
steps.speaker: AGENT
steps.text: I understand why that would be confusing. I’ll review the monthly charge first, and we can keep the rest of the conversation focused on your account.
steps.description: 客服复述问题边界，让当前服务问题成为对话主线。

steps.label: 客户表达不满
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: The monthly fee feels unfair and expensive, and I need to know exactly what it covers.
steps.description: 客户明确表达费用不满；费用情绪变为负面，投诉信号变为 active。

steps.label: 客服说明核查动作
steps.speaker: AGENT
steps.text: I’ve checked the account. The charge is linked to the savings service, and I’ll explain what it covers before we discuss any next step.
steps.description: 客服给出核查进展，但没有绕过当前投诉直接做商业推荐。

steps.label: 客户要求先解决费用
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: I don’t want another offer right now; I just want this charge explained and fixed.
steps.description: 客户明确当前优先级，平台应把商业建议置于问题处理之后。

steps.label: 实时商业门控
steps.description: propensity 可以很高，但 OPEN complaint 使商业建议进入 SUPPRESS。

steps.label: 客服承诺先处理问题
steps.speaker: AGENT
steps.text: That makes sense. I’ll focus on resolving the charge first, and I won’t introduce another product while this issue is still open.
steps.description: 客服根据实时辅助确认服务顺序，先解决问题再判断后续建议。

steps.label: 客户确认解决方向
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: If the charge is removed and the explanation is clear, I’m happy to continue with you.
steps.description: 客户确认可接受的解决条件，对话从投诉转向处理方案。

steps.label: 客服提出费用处理
steps.speaker: AGENT
steps.text: I can reverse the unexpected fee and record the explanation for this call. Would that address the issue for you?
steps.description: 客服提出明确处理动作，等待客户确认后再改变投诉权威。

steps.label: 客户确认问题解决
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: Yes, that addresses it. I understand what happened now.
steps.description: 客户确认解释和处理结果，下一步可以由业务流程正式记录解决。

steps.label: 权威解决投诉
steps.description: 只有授权业务事件可以将 complaint authority 置为 RESOLVED。

steps.label: 客服确认服务问题已结束
steps.speaker: AGENT
steps.text: The billing issue is now marked resolved. If you’re comfortable, we can move on to any questions you still have.
steps.description: 权威状态已经解决，客服向客户确认可以进入下一主题。

steps.label: 客户转向储蓄咨询
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: I am comfortable now. I was also curious whether there is a simple way to build savings automatically.
steps.description: 客户在问题解决后主动提出 savings 话题，平台可以重新评估后续辅助。

steps.label: 生成有效辅助建议
steps.description: eligibility、product facts、guidance 和 bounded explanation 均通过后才发布推荐。

steps.label: 建议送达客服桌面
steps.description: 记录 server publish；这还不等同于浏览器已经应用。

steps.label: 客服桌面确认显示
steps.description: 记录 UI acknowledgement，并保持 lifecycle 单调。

steps.label: 结束通话
steps.description: 结束通话并撤回仍在生成或已显示的实时商业建议。

steps.label: 生成通话总结
steps.description: 绑定不可变 transcript snapshot，保存 summary、themes、sentiment 和 evidence。

steps.label: 重试与幂等
steps.description: 再次运行同一 job，不创建重复 interaction record。
